summary: Borr Drilling Ltd filed a Form 6-K on August 13, 2026, furnishing its Q2 2026 earnings presentation and press release. The filing covers financial results for the three and six months ended June 30, 2026, plus a webcast/conference call notice. It references a five-rig acquisition from Fontis but does not disclose terms. This is a routine earnings report, not a special-situation event. No board recommendation, advisors, or deal mechanics are stated. Watch for continued operational updates and the Fontis acquisition progress.
